plansDescription: Warplyn will always remain open source. Features offered for free will stay free; optional extras may be paid. AI provider charges are separate.
plansIntro: Warplyn will always remain open source under the MIT License. Features offered for free will stay free; optional extras may be paid.
plansEverything: Everything currently in the app is free to use.
plansEditor: Article editor, Drafts, and Revision history
plansAssistant: Editorial Assistant, when connected to an AI provider
plansFeedback: Style feedback, sourced Fact Checks, and translations
plansOpenCode: Open-source code under the MIT License
plansPlatforms: Windows and Linux · Downloads on GitHub
plansCostTitle: Your provider sets its own prices.
plansCostBody: AI assistance is optional. If you connect a provider, it may charge for the requests you send. That cost goes to the provider, not Warplyn.
plansFreeQuestion: Will free features ever become paid?
plansFreeAnswer: No. Features offered for free will stay free. Warplyn will always remain open source under the MIT License. Optional extras may be paid.
plansBillingQuestion: Will Warplyn charge me for AI?
plansBillingAnswer: Warplyn does not bill you for AI usage. Your connected provider may charge for requests. See the supported providers. You can also write without an AI connection.
plansPrivacyQuestion: Does Warplyn upload or sync my Articles?
plansPrivacyAnswer: No sync service is provided. Articles and Revision history are stored locally. When you request AI help, only the relevant text and context are sent to your chosen provider. Read the privacy overview for more detail.
plansCommercialQuestion: Can I use it for commercial writing?
plansCommercialAnswer: The MIT License allows commercial use. Your writing remains yours.
plansHelpAnswer: Read the documentation or open an issue on GitHub. The community can help with setup and report problems.
